arabic_html:
وَإِذْ تَأَذَّنَ رَبُّكُمْ لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ ۖ
وَلَئِن كَفَرْتُمْ إِنَّ عَذَابِى لَشَدِيدٌ ۞
translit: Wa idh taʾadhdhana rabbukum la-in shakartum la-azīdannakum, wa la-in kafartum inna ʿadhābī la-shadīd.
translation: And when your Lord proclaimed, 'If you are grateful, I will surely increase you; but if you deny, indeed My punishment is severe.'
explanation_html: Ibn Kathīr: thankfulness preserves and increases Allah's favor, while ingratitude risks its loss. So the increase Allah promises begins the moment you give thanks for what you already have.
explanation_vo: As Ibn Kathir explains, thankfulness preserves and increases Allah's favor, while ingratitude risks its loss. So the increase Allah promises begins the moment you give thanks for what you already have.
